name: Advantest (Singapore) Pte. Ltd.
capabilities: Test-interface solutions for wafer sort and final test
india_angle: Advantest to showcase latest test solutions at SEMICON India 2026.
summary: Advantest is a leading manufacturer of automatic test and measurement equipment crucial for semiconductor design and production. The company provides advanced test-interface solutions and system-level test solutions, serving applications in 5G, IoT, autonomous vehicles, and HPC. Advantest is committed to addressing emerging testing challenges and enhancing semiconductor production efficiency.
